intro.text: The duke of Diggen's Point's young nephew, who comes home with him as his new heir in place of Charlie.

items.text: A year after setting out with Charlie, the duke returned with Dirk as his heir and the princess of Dormancy as Dirk's wife, a match made to seal an alliance. The king had declared Charlie dead within hours of his ship vanishing on the Midnight Sea, and the duke adopted Dirk, exactly the heir he had always wanted.

The islanders were puzzled by the new heir, but free food and drink at the duke's party soon had them toasting his marriage. The nobles were delighted with him, and within days the common folk had stopped caring.

appearance.text: Six and a half feet tall, hugely muscled and handsome, with a perfectly straight jaw. He is around Charlie's age, in his late teens.

personality.text: A man of very few words who usually answers in one word or a single sentence; the narrator jokes that his jaw and his wits both belong on a marble bust.

items.text: A skilled fencer with the name of a war hero, though the one battle anyone cites as his is one where he lost ten thousand men.
